owner: Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic), Open Design local session
coverage_meaning: Semantic mapping and test plan. Identifier coverage is not behavioural coverage: no acceptance criterion is marked PASS from this package, and no rendered, interactive, accessibility or usability result is claimed anywhere in it.

requirements.title: Requirement vs Action
requirements.behavior: Create Requirement with no Action; link zero/multiple Actions; create basic Decision/Finding/Risk context without converting types.

requirements.title: Milestones
requirements.behavior: OWNER declares required Requirements with reason; evaluate each failed prerequisite; undefined required set stays UNASSESSED.
requirements.predicate: All declared required Requirements evaluate READY + COMPLETED + (valid VERIFIED or explicit valid NOT_REQUIRED). Undefined sets evaluate UNASSESSED with count unavailable.

requirements.title: Next Action
requirements.behavior: Read visible assigned NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS Actions with dependency READY; critical chain, due ascending/no due last, stable ID; explain exclusions.

requirements.title: Waiting On
requirements.behavior: Record party or condition, waiting reason and internal owner; response resolves relation only through permitted command, never auto-completes proof.

requirements.title: Dependencies and Blocker Logic
requirements.behavior: Inspect each incoming gate and downstream impact; reject self/duplicate/cycle/cross-Matter links; reopen preserves historical completed work.

requirements.title: Evidence Requirements
requirements.behavior: Draft criterion and required components/version/validity; show missing evidence as gap, not empty attachment.

requirements.title: Evidence Verification
requirements.behavior: Submit exact proof; designated non-submitter verifier records rationale; expiry/rejection/dispute/reversal recomputes aggregates.

requirements.title: Event History
requirements.behavior: Read actor, operation, before/after, effective and recorded time, reason and causal reference; corrections append, restricted security logs stay separate.

requirements.title: Matter Control Room
requirements.behavior: Blockers → Next Actions with adjacent Important Decisions → Waiting On → Milestones → Evidence Gaps → Changes; no fabricated score.

requirements.title: My Actions
requirements.behavior: Filter assigned authorized Actions by current actor; separate eligible, waiting and blocked groups; inspect related Requirement and return to queue.

requirements.title: Operational Grid
requirements.behavior: Search/filter/sort/page, choose density, select explicit rows, edit metadata with validation and preserved drafts; no arbitrary state dropdown.

requirements.title: Bulk Editing
requirements.behavior: Preview title, description, assigned internal owner, due date only; per-row atomic change+audit, persistent partial results and failed drafts.

requirements.title: Excel/CSV Import
requirements.behavior: Map type/date/source key/scoped references; preview invalid groups; deduplicate same source/key/content; changed content reconciles; imported verification remains claim.

requirements.title: Excel Export
requirements.behavior: Choose authorized scope/filter/as-of/timezone, include axes/version context; escape formula-leading values; recheck permission at retrieval.

requirements.title: Document Versions
requirements.behavior: Add distinct version; OWNER promotes with expected prior version/reason/impact; current and fixed-version evidence retain distinct semantics; signatures separate.

requirements.title: Regulatory Filing Lifecycle
requirements.behavior: Track canonical stages, guarded package/signatures, exact submitted versions, receipt/outcome separation, repeated cycles and OWNER negative/reopen controls.
requirements.guard: Receipt upload supplies artifact only; transition to Authority Review requires authorized observation/command. Receipt != Approval.

requirements.title: External Parties
requirements.behavior: Select same-Matter external party separately from internal accountable owner; external party has no implied account/access.

requirements.title: Simple Roles and Ownership
requirements.behavior: Require active Workspace AND explicit Matter membership; roles and verifier designation separate; assignment never grants access; revoke pending retrieval/writes.
requirements.assignment_rule: Both Matter EDITOR and OWNER can assign Actions in scope to active members.

requirements.title: Delta-Based Status Brief
requirements.behavior: Choose t1≤t2; changes (t1,t2] by recorded-time policy separate from outstanding at t2; stable provenance/order; draft export only.

requirements.title: Separate State Dimensions
requirements.behavior: Display execution, verification where applicable, dependency for Requirement/Action, timing and attention with reasons; server owns derived truth.

execution.note: Progress asserted by an accountable human; never auto-propagated between Action and Requirement.

applies_to: Action or Filing where proof is explicitly required

not_a_member.EXPIRED: Proof expiry is an input that makes the evaluator recompute the aggregate, and a recorded reason. It is not an axis member. Expired proof cannot support VERIFIED even where a prior decision remains historically accepted.

verification.note: NOT_REQUIRED arises only from an explicit applicability decision.

not_a_member.CIRCULAR_CONFLICT: A graph cycle is rejected at edge validation. The proposed edge is refused and the graph is unchanged; no record enters a conflict state and no cycle is displayed as an accepted graph.

dependency.note: Derived. READY when no incoming gate is unsatisfied; evaluated recursively on an acyclic graph.

timing.note: RULE-009 over the declared due date and the as-of time. A record with no due date is visibly unassessed for schedule.

attention.note: RULE-010 inputs, with the contributing reasons listed. No hidden ranking.

authority_model.rule: Persona, scoped read role and operation authority are three separate things and are never collapsed.
authority_model.persona: Who typically sits at a screen. Grants nothing. Never consulted when deciding whether a control appears.
authority_model.scoped_read: Scoped OWNER, EDITOR and VIEWER read the Matter, its records, documents and domain history, and export within scope, with rights rechecked at retrieval.
authority_model.workspace_scope: Create Matter and Workspace membership are Workspace OWNER operations, decided by the workspace role. A Workspace OWNER has no automatic read of a Matter they are not a member of.
owner_only: Matter settings and milestone required prerequisites
editor_and_owner: Requirement and Action create, edit and assignment
authority_model.verification: Conditional for EDITOR and OWNER: an explicitly designated verifier who is not the submitter. An OWNER is not automatically the verifier.
authority_model.denial_presentation: A denied read is uniform and discloses nothing about what exists. A denied mutation inside a readable record keeps the read, withholds only that control, and cites the approved row.

error_mapping.scope: UX consumer mapping only. This design defines nothing on the wire and never invents a status the contract does not define.
error_mapping.outcome_unknown_receipted: 503 outcome-unknown with a receipt: read the receipt for the attempt key, or retry the identical attempt under the same key so a stored outcome replays.
error_mapping.outcome_unknown_non_receipted: 503 outcome-unknown with no receipt (membership commands): outcome stays unknown until an authorised read confirms; re-issue only if that read shows the change absent; never auto-resend.
error_mapping.outcome_unknown_readback_lost: Revoked actor: protected values and draft purged; outcome remains unknown to that actor by design; a permitted earlier read never unlocks a resend.
error_mapping.w2_plus_operations: DEPENDENCY_PENDING. Requirement edit, bulk, import, filing stage and promotion statuses arrive with the contract revision that adds the operation.
error_mapping.removed_in_r8: The hard-coded concurrent-edit status used by R5 through R7 is removed. The current contract defines no such status, and collapsing 428, 412 and the two unknown-outcome cases into one code made the recovery advice wrong in three of them.

DR7-01.finding: Unapproved domain enum values in the implementation handoff
DR7-01.correction: EXPIRED and CIRCULAR_CONFLICT removed as axis members from spec, matrix and prototype. Expiry presented as a recompute input and a recorded reason; a cycle presented as an edge-validation rejection.

DR7-02.finding: Proof fallback asserted false causal facts outside three corrected examples
DR7-02.correction: Root cause removed from the presentation layer: a single derive layer computes gates, dependency, root causes, downstream reach and consequence from the typed edges, and every panel reads it. Absent fixture data is reported as absent, never as a negative fact.
DR7-02.evidence: checks/check_mock_dom_bootstrap.js (all 24 panels, RQ-11, RQ-07, RQ-03, RQ-05 regressions, missing-information fallback); checks/check_canonical_dataset_and_proof.py

DR7-03.finding: Stale-revision and unknown-outcome UX did not follow the live contract
DR7-03.correction: Eleven-row consumer mapping bound to contract revision 4, separating 428, 412, 422, 400, receipted and non-receipted unknown outcomes, lost readback, denied read, denied mutation, unavailable evaluator and undefined W2+ operations.

DR7-04.finding: Personas mixed with read access and mutation authority
DR7-04.correction: Every screen separates personas, scoped read roles and operation authority. Workspace-scoped operations routed through a workspace role. Denied read and denied mutation are different screens. All 24 matrix rows transcribed and compared with the approved file.
DR7-04.evidence: checks/check_mock_dom_bootstrap.js role matrix, SCR-01 leak and workspace-scope checks; checks/check_canonical_dataset_and_proof.py transcription check

DR7-05.finding: Six essential surfaces existed only as prose
DR7-05.correction: SCR-01, SCR-08, SCR-09, SCR-10, SCR-11 and SCR-13 built as working screens with their own layout, navigation, fields, actions, high-risk states and per-screen filter reset. Sticky drawer navigation added.
DR7-05.tier: SOURCE_CHECKED + MOCK_EXECUTED; rendered layout remains VERIFICATION_BLOCKED

DR7-06.finding: AC-137 study assets were not handed off
DR7-06.correction: Two 50-row datasets with full causal graphs, declared milestone prerequisites and scoped owners; a participant surface; a facilitator-only key whose expected answers are derived from the data, not written by hand.

DR7-07.finding: Self-checks passed while missing DOM ids and untested behaviour went undetected
DR7-07.correction: Strict mock DOM that refuses to invent an element and retains event listeners; negative mutation tests for a renamed and a deleted static id; delegation, native dismissal and IME tests driven through real dispatch; predicate boundary assertions; evidence tiers separated.

DR7-08.correction: Every file labelled R8 with the supersession recorded. The R4 export image is cited only as historical R4 evidence. Full canonical Golden Workflow sequences rendered; Atlas excerpts marked as examples.

verification_blocked.observation: No browser, renderer, screenshot or capture tool is present in this session’s tool environment.
verification_blocked.consequence: Every visual, geometric, interactive, assistive-technology and usability case is VERIFICATION_BLOCKED and is listed case by case in validation-plan.md. Rendered quality is not inferred from CSS, from R4 screenshots or from mock DOM execution.
